cortina.title: Cortina d'Ampezzo
cortina.subtitle: Legendary Dolomite playground — epic ski terrain and towering pinnacles
cortina.description: Cortina d'Ampezzo sits beneath dramatic limestone walls and hosts a diverse range of mountain activities year-round. In winter the area features large lift-linked ski zones, steep technical slopes on the Tofane and Faloria, and quieter corners for ski touring and telemark. In summer, a network of trails and via ferrata opens up alpine ridgelines for hiking, climbing and E-bike tours. The town itself is a cultural hub with mountain huts, guided excursions and local mountain guides available to craft tailor-made experiences for every level.
cortina.winterP1: Cortina d'Ampezzo is famous for the Tofane and Faloria areas — steep technical pistes, scenic gondolas and classic long runs. The dramatic Cinque Torri and the surrounding peaks offer superb skiing and iconic Dolomite panoramas.
cortina.winterP2: Beyond groomers, Cortina is a gateway for ski mountaineering and scenic winter hikes; evening events and mountain huts turn cold nights into memorable alpine evenings.
cortina.summerP1: In summer Cortina becomes a rock-climbing and hiking hub — via ferrata routes, alpine ridgelines and panoramic cycle paths across the Ampezzo valleys provide endless options.
cortina.summerP2: Popular summer activities include guided hikes to Rifugios, climbing the Dolomite walls, and scenic E-bike tours through the valleys and alpine meadows.

sappada.title: Sappada
sappada.subtitle: Charming alpine village with family-friendly slopes and scenic singletracks
sappada.description: Sappada is a charming alpine village known for its family-friendly slopes and scenic bike trails. The nearby valleys offer quiet singletracks and easy touring options for all levels. In winter you find gentle ski runs, local snow parks and calm telemark lines; in summer the area becomes a network of trails for mountain biking and hiking, perfect for family days or technical enduro rides.
sappada.winterP1: Sappada offers approachable slopes and gentle terrain, ideal for families and learners. Nearby backcountry routes and local huts provide easy touring and ski touring options.
sappada.winterP2: Evenings in Sappada feature cozy lodges and local Alpine culture — a quiet alternative to larger resorts.
sappada.summerP1: Summer opens flowy forest trails and scenic alpine tracks around Sappada for relaxed all-day rides.
sappada.summerP2: Guided mountain bike tours, e-bike outings and hilltop hikes make Sappada a great base for low-key multi-day adventures.

zoldoCivetta.title: Zoldo / Civetta
zoldoCivetta.subtitle: Wild ridgelines and secluded valleys — ideal for freeride and alpine adventures
zoldoCivetta.description: The Zoldo valley and the Civetta massif provide an authentic Dolomite experience away from the busiest resorts. In winter the area combines technical lift-served terrain in Civetta with quieter, steep telemark lines and backcountry possibilities in Zoldo. Snow conditions and varied topography make the area great for freeride and mountain touring. In summer, high alpine singletracks, forested descents and panoramic ridge trails attract mountain bikers and hikers looking for long rides and multi-day tours. Local huts (rifugi), classic via ferrata and scenic ridgelines complete the offering — ideal for riders and trekkers seeking solitude and challenge.
zoldoCivetta.winterP1: The Civetta ski area features long, well-prepared runs, steep couloirs and excellent freeride terrain. Zoldo complements the area with quieter valleys, classic telemark lines and a strong mountain culture.
zoldoCivetta.winterP2: In Zoldo you can also arrange night rides — guided evening excursions and moonlit descents that turn familiar slopes into a magical alpine experience under the stars.
zoldoCivetta.summerP1: Summer opens a network of singletrack and high alpine trails. Expect everything from flowing forest trails to long alpine descents and technical enduro lines.
zoldoCivetta.summerP2: Popular mountain bike tours from Zoldo take you through the Cadore valleys, across ridgelines and down into wide, scenic meadows — ideal for guided rides and multi-day excursions.

snowboard.title: Snowboard
snowboard.description: Let's learn together the basics of snowboarding, carving, freestyle, freeride and snow tours, all this and much more.
snowboard.extendedDescription: snowboard is not just a sport but also a lifestyle, in fact my goal is not only to teach you the technique but also to make you experience all the emotions that this can give us! Whether you are a beginner or an expert, whether you want to improve your riding or freestyle technique, or whether you are interested in exploring the beautiful Dolomites, we will try together to create a path suitable for your needs to achieve your goals while having fun.

telemark.title: Telemark
telemark.description: Discover one of the oldest and most original skiing disciplines, fun is guaranteed.
telemark.extendedDescription: Telemark skiing combines the grace of nordic skiing with the thrill of alpine descents, creating a unique and rewarding experience on the slopes. As one of the oldest and most elegant skiing disciplines, telemark offers a distinctive free-heel technique that provides exceptional control and fluidity. I guide you through the fundamentals of telemark skiing, from proper stance and weight distribution to mastering those signature telemark turns. Whether you're completely new to the sport or looking to refine your technique, the stunning terrain of the Dolomites offers endless opportunities for telemark adventures.

mountainBike.title: Mountain Bike
mountainBike.description: Organized tours in the most spectacular locations in the Dolomites, basic techniques, enduro and bike park approach.
mountainBike.extendedDescription: Explore the Dolomites on two wheels with guided mountain bike tours and instruction tailored to your skill level. From scenic cross-country routes through alpine meadows to technical enduro trails and bike park sessions, I offer comprehensive guidance for mountain bikers of all abilities. Learn fundamental techniques including body positioning, braking, cornering, and climbing, or push your limits on challenging descents and jumps. The Dolomites provide some of the most spectacular and diverse mountain biking terrain in the world, with routes ranging from family-friendly paths to adrenaline-pumping downhill tracks.

description.p1: Outdoor sports, mountains, and nature: these are definitely the experiences that best define me. My name is Lorenzo Panzera, better known as Panz, and a few years ago I managed to turn my passions into a job, becoming a certified instructor of Snowboard, Telemark, and Mountain Bike Guide. This is where I want to start to tell you more about what I do and what I offer.
description.p2:
As snowboard instructor and telemark ski instructor, I want to bring as many people as possible closer to two disciplines that share not only snow but also the feeling of freedom, creativity, adrenaline, and fun! I will guide you step by step from the basics if you are beginners, or by perfecting technique and style together if you are more experienced.



As a mountain bike guide, a sport that is gaining more and more ground also thanks to E-bikes, I will take you to discover the most famous and spectacular places in the Dolomites, without neglecting less known but equally worthy trails and routes.
description.title3: Where do I carry out these activities?
description.p3:
Starting from my base, in Pieve di Cadore, I usually work in Cortina d’Ampezzo, a strategic location that, however, allows me to reach all the main locations of the Dolomites, depending on your needs.



Regardless of what you choose to do, my main goal will be to convey to you the same passion and love that I feel for these sports and for the mountains.
